units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 48a:10">B. Kam. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>קביל עליה נ׳</he> he assumed the duty of guarding.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 48a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>עליה ידיה רמי נ׳</he> the duty of guarding rests upon him.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 7b:14">B. Bath. 7ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>רבנן לא צריכי נ׳</he> scholars require no guard; a. fr.—Pesik. Haḥod., p. 56ᵃ, v. <cite ref="N00588"><he>נַטְרוֹנָא</he></cite>.
